    title: Text = Field(max_length=200)
    impact: Text = Field(max_length=2000)
    recommendation: Text = Field(max_length=2000)
    citations: list[QACitation] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8)
    reproduction: Text = Field(max_length=2000)
    verification: Literal["not-executed"] = "not-executed"


class QAInspection(Contract):
    """A model or analyst proposes findings, never check success or closure."""

    schema_version: Literal["QAInspection/v1"] = "QAInspection/v1"
    findings: list[QAInspectionFinding] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=32)
    inspected_facets: list[Facet] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=7)
    limitations: list[Text] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=32)


class QACheckResult(Contract):
    id: CheckID
    request_sha256: Digest
    head_commit: Commit
    status: Literal["passed", "failed", "timed-out", "not-run", "output-limit"]
    exit_code: int | None = None
    started_at: Text
    finished_at: Text
    output: str = Field(default="", max_length=32768, repr=False)
    output_sha256: Digest

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def observed_execution(self) -> Self:
        if instant(self.finished_at) < instant(self.started_at):
            raise ValueError("Check finishes before starting")
        if (
            len(self.output.encode()) > 32768
            or hashlib.sha256(self.output.encode()).hexdigest() != self.output_sha256
        ):
            raise ValueError("Check output differs from captured bytes")
        if (
            (self.status == "passed" and self.exit_code != 0)
            or (self.status == "failed" and (self.exit_code is None or self.exit_code == 0))
            or (self.status == "not-run" and (self.exit_code is not None or self.output))
        ):
            raise ValueError("Check outcome contradicts exit code or execution evidence")
        return self


class QACriterionResult(Contract):
    story_id: Identifier
    criterion_index: int = Field(ge=0)
    criterion: Text
    finding_ids: list[Identifier] = Field(max_length=32)
    verification: Literal["not-established"] = "not-established"


class QAReviewReport(Contract):
    model_config = ConfigDict(hide_input_in_errors=True)
    schema_version: Literal["QAReviewReport/v1"] = "QAReviewReport/v1"
    request: QAReviewRequest
    request_sha256: Digest
    engine: Literal["local", "codex-cli", "ollama", "provided-inspection"]
    model: str | None = None
    inspection_status: Literal["completed", "not-requested", "rejected"] = "not-requested"
    model_attempts: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=1)
    model_calls: int | None = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=1)
    inspection: QAInspection
    checks: list[QACheckResult] = Field(max_length=7)
    recommendation: Literal["changes-required", "inconclusive", "ready-for-po"]
    missing_facets: list[Facet]
    criterion_count: int = Field(ge=0)
    criterion_matrix: list[QACriterionResult] = Field(max_length=4096)
    acceptance: Literal["not-established"] = "not-established"
    authority: Literal["advisory-only"] = "advisory-only"

    @property
    def report_sha256(self) -> str:
        return canonical_project_digest(self.model_dump())

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def grounded_report(self) -> Self:
        from ai_harness_compiler.qa import report_facts, validate_inspection

        request = QAReviewRequest.model_validate(self.request.model_dump())
        if self.request_sha256 != request.request_sha256:
            raise ValueError("QA report belongs to another request")
        validate_inspection(request, self.inspection)
        if self.engine in {"codex-cli", "ollama"} and not self.model:
            raise ValueError("Model-assisted review requires an explicit model")
        remote = self.engine in {"codex-cli", "ollama"}
        if self.model_attempts != (1 if remote else 0):
            raise ValueError("QA model-call accounting differs from engine")
        expected_calls = (1 if self.inspection_status == "completed" else None) if remote else 0
        if self.model_calls != expected_calls or (
            remote and self.inspection_status == "not-requested"
        ):
            raise ValueError("QA call certainty differs from the observed inspection outcome")
        if self.inspection_status != "completed" and (
            self.inspection.findings or self.inspection.inspected_facets
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unavailable inspection cannot supply findings or coverage")
        checks = [QACheckResult.model_validate(c.model_dump()) for c in self.checks]
        if [c.id for c in checks] != request.check_ids:
            raise ValueError("QA checks must account for each requested check in order")
        for check in checks:
            if (
                check.request_sha256 != self.request_sha256
                or check.head_commit != request.head_commit
            ):
                raise ValueError("Check evidence belongs to another revision")
            if instant(check.started_at) < instant(request.captured_at):
                raise ValueError("Check predates its request")
        if (
            self.recommendation,
            self.missing_facets,
            self.criterion_count,
            self.criterion_matrix,
        ) != report_facts(request, self.inspection, checks):
            raise ValueError("QA report conclusions differ from captured evidence")
        return self


class SprintClosureAssessment(Contract):
    model_config = ConfigDict(hide_input_in_errors=True)
    schema_version: Literal["SprintClosureAssessment/v1"] = "SprintClosureAssessment/v1"
    qa: QAReviewReport
    qa_sha256: Digest
    sprint_goal: Text
    blocking_findings: list[Identifier]
    carryover: list[Identifier]
    check_failures: list[CheckID]
    conclusion: Literal["changes-required", "inconclusive", "ready-for-po"]
    full_delivery_established: Literal[False] = False
    human_decision_required: Literal[True] = True
    sprint_closed: Literal[False] = False
    completion_authority: Literal["none"] = "none"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def derived_closure(self) -> Self:
        from ai_harness_compiler.qa import closure_facts

        qa = QAReviewReport.model_validate(self.qa.model_dump())
        if self.qa_sha256 != qa.report_sha256:
            raise ValueError("Closure assessment refers to another QA report")
        if (
            self.sprint_goal,
            self.blocking_findings,
            self.carryover,
            self.check_failures,
            self.conclusion,
        ) != closure_facts(qa):
            raise ValueError("Closure assessment differs from QA evidence")
        return self


class QAFindingResolutionProposal(Contract):
    """Evidence for a human decision; never a model-generated resolution."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(hide_input_in_errors=True)
    schema_version: Literal["QAFindingResolutionProposal/v1"] = "QAFindingResolutionProposal/v1"
    previous: QAReviewReport
    current: QAReviewReport
    finding_id: Identifier
    citations: list[QACitation] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8)
    check_ids: list[CheckID] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=7)
    rationale: Text = Field(max_length=2000)
    status: Literal["awaiting-human-review"] = "awaiting-human-review"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def bound_evidence(self) -> Self:
        from ai_harness_compiler.qa import validate_resolution_proposal

        validate_resolution_proposal(self)
        return self


class QAFindingResolutionReview(Contract):
    model_config = ConfigDict(hide_input_in_errors=True)
    schema_version: Literal["QAFindingResolutionReview/v1"] = "QAFindingResolutionReview/v1"
    proposal: QAFindingResolutionProposal
    decision: Literal["confirm", "reject"]
    actor: Identifier
    reviewed_at: Text
    comment: Text = Field(max_length=2000)
    completion_authority: Literal["none"] = "none"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def separate_human_decision(self) -> Self:
        proposal = QAFindingResolutionProposal.model_validate(self.proposal.model_dump())
        if self.actor in {
            "vera",
            "nexo",
            proposal.previous.request.author,
            proposal.current.request.author,
        }:
            raise ValueError("Resolution reviewer must be separate from authors and agents")
        latest = max(instant(c.finished_at) for c in proposal.current.checks)
        if instant(self.reviewed_at) < latest:
            raise ValueError("Human review predates current check evidence")
        return self


class QAReviewComparison(Contract):
    model_config = ConfigDict(hide_input_in_errors=True)
    schema_version: Literal["QAReviewComparison/v1"] = "QAReviewComparison/v1"
    previous: QAReviewReport
    current: QAReviewReport
    cleared_check_failures: list[CheckID]
    pending_previous_findings: list[Identifier]
    resolution_reviews: list[QAFindingResolutionReview] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=32)
    resolved_previous_findings: list[Identifier] = Field(default_factory=list)
    semantic_resolution: Literal["not-established"] = "not-established"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def observed_changes_only(self) -> Self:
        from ai_harness_compiler.qa import comparison_facts, resolution_facts

        previous = QAReviewReport.model_validate(self.previous.model_dump())
        current = QAReviewReport.model_validate(self.current.model_dump())
        cleared, pending = comparison_facts(previous, current)
        resolved = resolution_facts(previous, current, self.resolution_reviews)
        if (
            self.cleared_check_failures,
            self.pending_previous_findings,
            self.resolved_previous_findings,
        ) != (cleared, [p for p in pending if p not in resolved], resolved):
            raise ValueError("QA comparison differs from observed checks and open findings")
        return self

    root_cause: Literal["not-established"] = "not-established"

    memory_promotion: Literal["human-review-required"] = "human-review-required"

"""Explicit, bounded Git capture; source bytes are data, never instructions."""

import hashlib
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
from pathlib import Path

from ai_harness_compiler.models.qa import (
    QAReviewComparison,
    QAReviewRequest,
    ReviewSource,
    safe_review_path,
)
from ai_harness_compiler.models.scrum import SprintSnapshot, instant
from ai_harness_compiler.scrum_collection import timestamp
from ai_harness_compiler.scrum_planning import assert_current


def stop_tree(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]) -> None:
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                ["taskkill", "/F", "/T", "/PID", str(process.pid)],
                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                timeout=5,
                check=False,
            )
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            process.kill()
    else:
        try:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass


def bounded_process(
    command: list[str], root: Path, timeout: float, limit: int
) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
    creationflags = 0
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        creationflags = subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        cwd=root,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        start_new_session=sys.platform != "win32",
        creationflags=creationflags,
    )
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    exceeded: list[bool] = []

    def consume() -> None:
        used = 0
        assert process.stdout is not None
        while chunk := process.stdout.read(4096):
            remaining = max(0, limit - used)
            chunks.append(chunk[:remaining])
            used += len(chunk)
            if used > limit:
                exceeded.append(True)
                stop_tree(process)
                break

    reader = threading.Thread(target=consume, daemon=True)
    reader.start()
    status = "completed"
    try:
        process.wait(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        stop_tree(process)
        process.wait()
        status = "timed-out"
    finally:
        reader.join(timeout=2)
        if process.stdout is not None and not reader.is_alive():
            process.stdout.close()
    if reader.is_alive() or exceeded:
        stop_tree(process)
        status = "output-limit"
    # UTF-8 replacement may expand bytes; enforce the limit on the final text too.
    output = b"".join(chunks).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    output = output.encode()[:limit].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    return process.returncode, output, status


def git(root: Path, *args: str, limit: int = 65536) -> str:
    code, output, status = bounded_process(
        [
            "git",
            "--no-optional-locks",
            "-c",
            "core.fsmonitor=false",
            "--no-pager",
            "--no-replace-objects",
            *args,
        ],
        root,
        10,
        limit,
    )
    if code != 0 or status != "completed":
        raise ValueError("QA Git read failed or exceeded budget")
    return output


def capture(
    root: Path,
    snapshot: SprintSnapshot,
    base: str,
    head: str,
    author: str,
    paths: list[str],
    *,
    check_ids: list[str] | None = None,
) -> QAReviewRequest:
    from pydantic import TypeAdapter

    from ai_harness_compiler.models.qa import Commit

    TypeAdapter(Commit).validate_python(base, strict=True)
    TypeAdapter(Commit).validate_python(head, strict=True)
    root = root.resolve()
    if Path(git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").strip()).resolve() != root:
        raise ValueError("QA root must be the repository root")
    if not paths:
        raise ValueError("Select explicit review source paths; no implicit repository ingestion")
    if len(paths) > 32 or len(set(paths)) != len(paths):
        raise ValueError("Select at most 32 unique source paths")
    for revision in (base, head):
        if git(root, "rev-parse", f"{revision}^{{commit}}").strip() != revision:
            raise ValueError("QA revision must resolve to the exact commit")
    sources = []
    for path in paths:
        safe_review_path(path)
        tree = git(root, "ls-tree", head, "--", path).split()
        if len(tree) < 4 or tree[0] not in {"100644", "100755"}:
            raise ValueError("QA sources must be regular tracked files")
        content = git(root, "show", f"{head}:{path}")
        sources.append(
            ReviewSource(
                path=path, content=content, sha256=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
            )
        )
    changed = git(
        root, "diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--name-only", "-z", base, head
    ).split("\0")
    diff = git(
        root, "diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--unified=3", base, head, "--", *paths
    )
    data: dict[str, object] = {
        "snapshot": snapshot.model_dump(),
        "base_commit": base,
        "head_commit": head,
        "author": author,
        "captured_at": timestamp(),
        "sources": [s.model_dump() for s in sources],
        "diff": diff,
        "diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(diff.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "excluded_paths": [p for p in changed if p and p not in paths],
    }
    if check_ids is not None:
        data["check_ids"] = check_ids
    request = QAReviewRequest.model_validate(data)
    assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
    return request


def assert_current_comparison(comparison: QAReviewComparison, root: Path, now: str) -> None:
    comparison = QAReviewComparison.model_validate(comparison.model_dump())
    assert_current_request(comparison.current.request, root, now)
    if any(instant(review.reviewed_at) > instant(now) for review in comparison.resolution_reviews):
        raise ValueError("Resolution decision lies in the future")


def assert_current_request(request: QAReviewRequest, root: Path, now: str) -> None:
    request = QAReviewRequest.model_validate(request.model_dump())
    assert_current(request.snapshot, root, now)
    age = (instant(now) - instant(request.captured_at)).total_seconds()
    if not 0 <= age <= request.max_age_seconds:
        raise ValueError("QA request expired or lies in the future")
    root = root.resolve()
    if git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip() != request.head_commit:
        raise ValueError("QA head changed; capture a new review")
    if Path(git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").strip()).resolve() != root:
        raise ValueError("QA root must be the repository root")
    if git(root, "rev-parse", f"{request.base_commit}^{{commit}}").strip() != request.base_commit:
        raise ValueError("QA base revision does not match an existing commit")
    if git(
        root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=normal", "--ignore-submodules=all"
    ).strip():
        raise ValueError("QA requires a clean tracked revision and no untracked source files")
    changed = git(
        root,
        "diff",
        "--no-ext-diff",
        "--no-textconv",
        "--name-only",
        "-z",
        request.base_commit,
        request.head_commit,
    ).split("\0")
    selected = {source.path for source in request.sources}
    excluded = [path for path in changed if path and path not in selected]
    if request.excluded_paths != excluded:
        raise ValueError("QA excluded paths differ from complete Git changes")
    if (
        git(
            root,
            "diff",
            "--no-ext-diff",
            "--no-textconv",
            "--unified=3",
            request.base_commit,
            request.head_commit,
            "--",
            *(s.path for s in request.sources),
        )
        != request.diff
    ):
        raise ValueError("QA captured diff differs from Git revisions")
    entries = git(
        root, "ls-tree", "-z", request.head_commit, "--", *(s.path for s in request.sources)
    ).split("\0")
    tree = {}
    for entry in entries:
        if entry:
            metadata_text, _, name = entry.partition("\t")
            tree[name] = metadata_text.split()
    for source in request.sources:
        path = (root / source.path).resolve()
        if not path.is_relative_to(root):
            raise ValueError("QA source escapes repository")
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            content = stream.read(65537)
        if len(content) > 65536 or hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != source.sha256:
            raise ValueError("QA source differs from the captured revision")
        # The working tree alone cannot authenticate an imported capture.
        metadata = tree.get(source.path, [])
        if len(metadata) != 3 or metadata[0] not in {"100644", "100755"}:
            raise ValueError("QA source is not a regular tracked file")
        blob = hashlib.sha1(f"blob {len(content)}\0".encode() + content).hexdigest()
        if metadata[1:] != ["blob", blob]:
            raise ValueError("QA capture differs from Git revision")

"""Fixed check commands, trusted revision opt-in and total/per-command budgets."""

import hashlib
import sys
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from time import monotonic

from ai_harness_compiler.models.qa import CheckID, QACheckResult, QAReviewRequest
from ai_harness_compiler.qa_collection import assert_current_request, bounded_process
from ai_harness_compiler.scrum_collection import timestamp

COMMANDS: dict[CheckID, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "lint": ("-m", "ruff", "check", "."),
    "format": ("-m", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."),
    "typing": ("-m", "mypy", "src"),
    "tests": ("-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"),
    "schemas": ("scripts/export_schemas.py", "--check"),
    "repo-policy": ("scripts/generate_repo_agents.py", "--check"),
    "sprint-plan": ("scripts/generate_sprint_plan.py", "--check"),
}


def run_checks(
    request: QAReviewRequest,
    root: Path,
    trusted_revision: str | None = None,
    on_result: Callable[[QACheckResult], None] | None = None,
) -> list[QACheckResult]:
    request = QAReviewRequest.model_validate(request.model_dump())
    assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
    if trusted_revision is not None and trusted_revision != request.head_commit:
        raise ValueError("Trusted check revision differs from reviewed head")
    deadline = monotonic() + request.total_check_seconds
    results = []
    for check_id in request.check_ids:
        started = timestamp()
        output, code, state = "", None, "not-run"
        remaining = deadline - monotonic()
        if trusted_revision is not None and remaining > 0:
            assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
            remaining = deadline - monotonic()
            if remaining > 0:
                try:
                    code, output, termination = bounded_process(
                        [
                            sys.executable,
                            *COMMANDS[check_id],
                            *(
                                ["--sprint", request.snapshot.observation.sprint_id]
                                if check_id == "sprint-plan"
                                else []
                            ),
                        ],
                        root,
                        min(request.check_timeout_seconds, remaining),
                        32768,
                    )
                    state = (
                        termination
                        if termination != "completed"
                        else "passed"
                        if code == 0
                        else "failed"
                    )
                except OSError:
                    state, code, output = "failed", -1, "Fixed check process unavailable."

        results.append(
            QACheckResult.model_validate(
                {
                    "id": check_id,
                    "request_sha256": request.request_sha256,
                    "head_commit": request.head_commit,
                    "status": state,
                    "exit_code": code,
                    "started_at": started,
                    "finished_at": timestamp(),
                    "output": output,
                    "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest(),
                }
            )
        )
        if on_result is not None:
            on_result(results[-1])
    assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
    return results

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from ai_harness_compiler.compiler import json_text
from ai_harness_compiler.models.qa import (
    QAFindingResolutionProposal,
    QAFindingResolutionReview,
    QAInspection,
    QAReviewReport,
    QAReviewRequest,
)
from ai_harness_compiler.models.scrum import SprintSnapshot, instant
from ai_harness_compiler.qa import (
    assess_closure,
    compare_reviews,
    incident_candidates,
    project_for,
    review_report,
)
from ai_harness_compiler.qa_collection import assert_current_request, capture
from ai_harness_compiler.qa_runner import COMMANDS, run_checks

def add_commands(commands: argparse._SubParsersAction[argparse.ArgumentParser]) -> None:
    command = commands.add_parser("qa", help="Vera evidence-bound QA review")
    sub = command.add_subparsers(dest="qa_command", required=True)
    collect = sub.add_parser("capture")
    collect.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    collect.add_argument("--snapshot", type=Path, required=True)
    collect.add_argument("--base", required=True)
    collect.add_argument("--head", required=True)
    collect.add_argument("--author", required=True)
    collect.add_argument("--source", action="append", required=True)
    collect.add_argument("--checks", nargs="+", choices=list(COMMANDS))
    collect.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    run = sub.add_parser("run")
    run.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    run.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    run.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    run.add_argument(
        "--engine", choices=["local", "primary", "codex-cli", "ollama"], default="local"
    )
    run.add_argument("--model")
    run.add_argument(
        "--trusted-checks-at", help="Explicitly trust executing fixed checks at this head"
    )
    run.add_argument(
        "--inspection", type=Path, help="Import advisory findings; never executed evidence"
    )
    run.add_argument(
        "--team", action="store_true", help="Run Vera and Nexo with persistent PO gate"
    )
    assess = sub.add_parser("assess")
    assess.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    assess.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    assess.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    compare = sub.add_parser("compare")
    compare.add_argument("previous", type=Path)
    compare.add_argument("current", type=Path)
    compare.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    compare.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    compare.add_argument("--resolution", type=Path, action="append", default=[])
    compare.add_argument("--team-output", type=Path)
    propose = sub.add_parser("propose-resolution")
    propose.add_argument("previous", type=Path)
    propose.add_argument("current", type=Path)
    propose.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    propose.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    propose.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    review = sub.add_parser("review-resolution")
    review.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    review.add_argument("--decision", choices=["confirm", "reject"], required=True)
    review.add_argument("--actor", required=True)
    review.add_argument("--comment", required=True)
    review.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    review.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)


def save_new(path: Path, data: dict[str, object]) -> None:
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json_text(data))


def execute(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("QA output already exists; choose a new path")
    root = args.repository.resolve()
    if args.qa_command == "propose-resolution":
        previous = read_model(args.previous, QAReviewReport)
        current = read_model(args.current, QAReviewReport)
        assert_current_request(current.request, root, timestamp())
        if args.evidence.stat().st_size > 32768:
            raise ValueError("Resolution evidence exceeds its budget")
        data = json.loads(args.evidence.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data) != {
            "finding_id",
            "citations",
            "check_ids",
            "rationale",
        }:
            raise ValueError(
                "Resolution evidence requires finding, citations, checks and rationale"
            )
        proposal = QAFindingResolutionProposal.model_validate(
            {
                **data,
                "previous": previous.model_dump(),
                "current": current.model_dump(),
            }
        )
        save_new(args.output, proposal.model_dump())
        print("Resolution proposed; explicit human review pending. No acceptance or closure.")
        return 0
    if args.qa_command == "review-resolution":
        proposal = read_model(args.input, QAFindingResolutionProposal)
        assert_current_request(proposal.current.request, root, timestamp())
        review = QAFindingResolutionReview(
            proposal=proposal,
            decision=args.decision,
            actor=args.actor,
            reviewed_at=timestamp(),
            comment=args.comment,
        )
        save_new(args.output, review.model_dump())
        print("Recorded declared human resolution decision; no story acceptance or sprint closure.")
        return 0
    if args.qa_command == "compare":
        previous, current = (
            read_model(args.previous, QAReviewReport),
            read_model(args.current, QAReviewReport),
        )
        assert_current_request(current.request, root, timestamp())
        resolutions = [read_model(path, QAFindingResolutionReview) for path in args.resolution]
        if any(instant(r.reviewed_at) > instant(timestamp()) for r in resolutions):
            raise ValueError("Resolution decision lies in the future")
        comparison = compare_reviews(previous, current, resolutions)
        if args.team_output is not None and args.team_output.exists():
            raise ValueError("Team output already exists")
        save_new(args.output, comparison.model_dump())
        if args.team_output is not None:
            from ai_harness_compiler.models.team import TeamConfig
            from ai_harness_compiler.team.runtime import prepare_team

            config = TeamConfig(
                project=project_for(current.request),
                selected=[s.id for s in current.request.snapshot.stories],
                request="Review finding resolution evidence and pending findings with Nexo.",
                mode="ask",
                repository_root=str(root),
                scrum_snapshot=current.request.snapshot,
                qa_report=current,
                qa_comparison=comparison,
            )
            prepare_team(config, args.team_output)
        print("Compared observed checks; missing model findings do not establish resolution.")
        return 0
    if args.qa_command == "capture":
        request = capture(
            root,
            read_model(args.snapshot, SprintSnapshot),
            args.base,
            args.head,
            args.author,
            args.source,
            check_ids=args.checks,
        )
        save_new(args.output, request.model_dump())
        print(f"Captured QA request {request.request_sha256}; no code executed.")
        return 0
    if args.qa_command == "assess":
        report = read_model(args.input, QAReviewReport)
        assert_current_request(report.request, root, timestamp())
        save_new(args.output, assess_closure(report).model_dump())
        print("Saved advisory closure assessment; sprint remains open.")
        return 0
    request = read_model(args.input, QAReviewRequest)
    assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
    engine, model = args.engine, args.model
    if args.inspection is not None and (engine != "local" or model is not None):
        raise ValueError("Imported inspection cannot be combined with a model invocation")
    if engine == "local" and model is not None:
        raise ValueError("Local review cannot select a model")
    if engine == "primary" or (engine in {"codex-cli", "ollama"} and model is None):
        from ai_harness_compiler.model_policy import load_model_policy

        policy = load_model_policy()
        endpoint = policy.primary if engine == "primary" else policy.endpoint(engine)
        engine, model = endpoint.provider, endpoint.model if model is None else model
    checks = run_checks(
        request,
        root,
        args.trusted_checks_at,
        on_result=lambda c: print(f"QA check {c.id}: {c.status}", file=sys.stderr),
    )
    status = "not-requested"
    calls: int | None = 0
    attempts = 0
    inspection = QAInspection(
        limitations=[
            "No semantic inspection requested; checks alone do not establish business correctness.",
            "Criterion acceptance, performance and cost are not established by this review.",
        ]
    )
    if args.inspection is not None:
        engine, status = "provided-inspection", "completed"
        inspection = read_model(args.inspection, QAInspection)
    elif engine in {"codex-cli", "ollama"}:
        from ai_harness_compiler.adapters.qa_inspection import inspect

        calls, attempts = None, 1
        try:
            inspection = inspect(request, checks, root, engine, model or "")
            status = "completed"
            calls = 1
        except ModuleNotFoundError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            status = "rejected"
            inspection = QAInspection(
                limitations=[
                    "Model inspection failed or was rejected; no fallback or semantic pass.",
                ]
            )
    report = review_report(
        request,
        inspection,
        checks,
        engine=engine,
        model=model,
        inspection_status=status,
        model_calls=calls,
        model_attempts=attempts,
    )
    assert_current_request(request, root, timestamp())
    args.output.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    save_new(args.output / "qa-report.json", report.model_dump())
    save_new(args.output / "closure-assessment.json", assess_closure(report).model_dump())
    save_new(
        args.output / "incident-candidates.json",
        {
            "candidates": [c.model_dump() for c in incident_candidates(report)],
            "memory_modified": False,
        },
    )
    if args.team:
        from ai_harness_compiler.models.team import TeamConfig
        from ai_harness_compiler.team.runtime import prepare_team

        config = TeamConfig(
            project=project_for(request),
            selected=[s.id for s in request.snapshot.stories],
            request="Vera reviews QA evidence; Nexo prepares sprint review and explicit carryover.",
            mode="ask",
            repository_root=str(root),
            scrum_snapshot=request.snapshot,
            qa_report=report,
        )
        prepare_team(config, args.output / "team")
    print(
        f"Vera: {report.recommendation}; {len(report.inspection.findings)} advisory findings; "
        f"{sum(c.status == 'passed' for c in checks)} checks passed; acceptance not established."
    )
    return 0

def git(root, *args):
    result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=root, capture_output=True, check=True)
    return result.stdout.decode().strip()


def repo_request(tmp_path):
    root = repository(tmp_path / "repo")
    (root / "src").mkdir()
    (root / "src/approval.py").write_text(
        "def authorize(approved):\n    return True\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    (root / ".gitignore").write_text(".factory/\n", newline="\n")
    git(root, "init")
    git(root, "config", "user.name", "QA Fixture")
    git(root, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
    git(root, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
    git(root, "add", ".")
    git(root, "commit", "-m", "fixture")
    head = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    snapshot = observe(collect(root, "demo", REPO, "sprint-2-5"))
    return root, capture(
        root, snapshot, head, head, "engineer", ["src/approval.py"], check_ids=["tests"]
    )

"""A resolved finding needs new evidence and a separate explicit human decision."""

import hashlib

import pytest
from test_qa import check, finding, inspection, request
from test_scrum_observer import NOW

from ai_harness_compiler.models.qa import (
    QAFindingResolutionProposal,
    QAFindingResolutionReview,
    QAReviewComparison,
    ReviewSource,
)
from ai_harness_compiler.qa import compare_reviews, review_report


def proposal():
    old = request()
    previous = review_report(
        old,
        inspection([finding()]),
        [check(old)],
        engine="provided-inspection",
        inspection_status="completed",
    )
    current_request = request()
    current_request.head_commit = "c" * 40
    code = "def authorize(approved):\n    return approved\n"
    current_request.sources = [
        ReviewSource(
            path="src/approval.py", content=code, sha256=hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest()
        )
    ]
    current = review_report(
        current_request,
        inspection(),
        [check(current_request)],
        engine="provided-inspection",
        inspection_status="completed",
    )
    return QAFindingResolutionProposal(
        previous=previous,
        current=current,
        finding_id="approval-bypass",
        citations=[{"path": "src/approval.py", "line": 2, "quote": "return approved"}],
        check_ids=["tests"],
        rationale="False approval now returns False; regression check passed.",
    )


def test_proposal_alone_cannot_clear_a_finding_and_confirmation_is_scoped():
    proposed = proposal()
    pending = compare_reviews(proposed.previous, proposed.current)
    assert pending.pending_previous_findings == ["approval-bypass"]
    assert proposed.status == "awaiting-human-review"
    review = QAFindingResolutionReview(
        proposal=proposed,
        decision="confirm",
        actor="fixture-human-reviewer",
        reviewed_at=NOW,
        comment="Reviewed explicit fixture evidence.",
    )
    compared = compare_reviews(proposed.previous, proposed.current, [review])
    assert compared.resolved_previous_findings == ["approval-bypass"]
    assert compared.pending_previous_findings == []
    assert compared.semantic_resolution == "not-established"
    assert compared.current.acceptance == "not-established"
    assert review.completion_authority == "none"
    data = compared.model_dump()
    data["resolution_reviews"] = []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        QAReviewComparison.model_validate(data)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("actor", ["vera", "nexo", "engineer"])
def test_agents_and_authors_cannot_be_resolution_reviewers(actor):

def test_rejection_preserves_pending_and_duplicate_decisions_are_rejected():
    p = proposal()
    review = QAFindingResolutionReview(
        proposal=p,
        decision="reject",
        actor="fixture-human",
        reviewed_at=NOW,
        comment="Evidence insufficient",
    )
    result = compare_reviews(p.previous, p.current, [review])
    assert result.pending_previous_findings == [p.finding_id]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Duplicate"):
        compare_reviews(p.previous, p.current, [review, review])


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "change", ["finding", "citation", "check", "revision", "criteria", "facet"]
)
def test_resolution_rejects_unbound_evidence(change):
    p = proposal().model_dump()
    if change == "finding":
        p["finding_id"] = "unknown"
    elif change == "citation":
        p["citations"][0]["quote"] = "return True"
    elif change == "check":
        p["check_ids"] = ["lint"]
    elif change == "revision":
        p["previous"] = p["current"]
    elif change == "criteria":
        # A modified report is rejected before it can authorize a resolution.
        p["current"]["criterion_matrix"][0]["criterion"] = "Different rule"
    else:
        p["current"]["inspection"]["inspected_facets"].remove("business")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        QAFindingResolutionProposal.model_validate(p)


def test_resolution_cannot_be_replayed_against_another_report():
    p = proposal()
    review = QAFindingResolutionReview(
        proposal=p,
        decision="confirm",
        actor="fixture-human",
        reviewed_at=NOW,
        comment="Evidence checked",
    )
    other = p.current.model_copy(deep=True)
    other.model = "changed-metadata"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compare_reviews(p.previous, other, [review])
